gaps.lead: The Minister sat down, and immediately the journalists began shouting.
gaps.sentence: ___ sat down than the journalists began shouting.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had + subject + participle … than' with inversion replaces 'and immediately'.

gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: Most of the children ignored what the teacher had told them.
gaps.sentence: Few of the children ___ what the teacher had told them.

gaps.lead: She speaks French better than her brother does.
gaps.explanation: 'Doesn't speak French as well as' reverses the comparison.

gaps.lead: Reporters expect the trial to last several weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Reporters expect it to last' becomes 'it is expected to last'.
